title: Assign a named area to the theater billboard
goal: Draw two lines of grid area and put the three pieces of information into the corresponding positions with names.
summary: grid-template-areas Each string represents one line, and each name in the string corresponds to one cell. Adjacent grids with the same name can form a larger rectangular area, and grid-area is used to place grid items into this area.
tasks: Write two lines for .show-board grid-template-areas. The first line is "overview overview" and the second line is "stage tickets".
Set grid-area to .show-overview, .stage-crew and .front-desk, using overview, stage and tickets in sequence.

example.note: The recipe picture occupies the first line, and the ingredients and methods are placed on the left and right sides of the second line respectively.

hint: When two areas exchange positions, check the order in the second string. The name of each grid-area must be consistent with the corresponding grid in the diagram.
